title: Readjustment-Day Credit on Alignment Services & Plans Renewals
content:
A readjustment-day credit is taken off the renewal price of an expired Alignment Services & Plans month-based plan. It is read from the expired plan's readjustments booked as guarantee readjustments, by their dates:

| Guarantee readjustment under the expired plan | Credit |
|---|---|
| one is dated the renewal date | 25.00 |
| none on the renewal date, but the latest came within 30 calendar days before the renewal date | 12.50 |
| otherwise | 0.00 |

The credit is worked out on its own and taken off the renewal price, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical renewal dates):** latest guarantee readjustment 30 days before the renewal → 12.50; 31 days before → 0.00; on the renewal date itself → 25.00.
